desc: Ideation: use monotone tracked ratings with difference array/Fenwick lower_bound and hybrid full-domain/sorted-query subset.
Implement fast input and hybrid setup: parse all ints, choose mode by power-of-two size, initialize F1/D/Fenwick for full domain or sorted queries.
Process all N contests using lower_bound for L and R+1 and point updates to F1/D/Fenwick.
Reconstruct final ratings from D and answer queries in original order.
Verify on the three public samples (passed) and edge cases (single query, duplicates, no increments, max R, all increments).
